exact_goal: Canonical Lemma 2.7: uniform little-o envelope for failure of combined expansion conditional on any PreliminaryGood forms, over full independently uniform hash functions and arbitrary public Geometry.
proof_route: Flatten full hash functions to functions on layer-address pairs. Ignoring the layer tag on hash output only decreases image cardinality, so generic bucket occupancy safely overestimates collision loss.

If image cardinality plus r is at most domain size a, choose a-r representative inputs covering all output values. For each fixed representative subset, condition on its hash values; independent remaining values land in its image with probability at most (a/b)^r. Union over at most 2^a representative subsets.

Under PreliminaryGood and failure for row set S, preliminary neighbor cardinal minus combined neighbor cardinal exceeds (epsilon*k-d+1)*|S|. Any fixed natural L at most epsilon*k-d+1 therefore gives at least L*|S| generic occupancy loss.
Use a<=k*|S| and b>=n/(2k) to bound fixed S by [2^k*(2*k^2*n^(-epsilon))^L]^|S|. Union over at most m^|S| row subsets; bound positive geometric sum by twice its base.
Choose L=floor(epsilon*k-d+1), prove epsilon*L-2d^2>1/epsilon using exact ceiling parameters, then use the real-power limit. Root is supplying analytic helpers.

theorem uniformProb_prod_fibers {A B : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    [Nonempty A] [Nonempty B] (E : A × B → Prop) :
    uniformProb E = (∑ a : A, uniformProb (fun b : B => E (a, b))) / Fintype.card A
nodes.proof_route: Rewrite finite uniform probabilities as event cardinalities, split the product cardinality into fiber cardinalities, and normalize by |A|*|B|.

theorem uniformProb_prod_le_of_fibers {A B : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    [Nonempty A] [Nonempty B] (E : A × B → Prop) (C : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ a, uniformProb (fun b : B => E (a, b)) ≤ C) : uniformProb E ≤ C
nodes.proof_route: Apply the exact fiber-average identity and bound each fiber probability by C.

theorem exists_image_representatives {I V : Type*} [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq V] (D : Finset I) (f : I → V) :
    ∃ R ⊆ D, R.card = (D.image f).card ∧ R.image f = D.image f
nodes.proof_route: Choose an injective subset of the finite input set surjecting onto its image; its cardinality equals image cardinality.

theorem exists_image_cover_of_loss {I V : Type*} [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq V] (D : Finset I) (f : I → V) (r : ℕ)
    (hloss : (D.image f).card + r ≤ D.card) :
    ∃ R ∈ D.powersetCard (D.card - r), D.image f ⊆ R.image f
nodes.proof_route: Extend distinct representatives to a subset of size |D|-r using the assumed loss bound.

theorem uniformProb_image_covered_le {I V : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype V] [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq V]
    [Nonempty V] (D R : Finset I) (hRD : R ⊆ D) :
    uniformProb (fun f : I → V => D.image f ⊆ R.image f) ≤
      ((R.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card V) ^ (D.card - R.card)
nodes.proof_route: Split the full function space into representative inputs and their complement; condition on the representative values; exact finite-product independence gives one |R|/|V| factor per input of D\R.

theorem uniformProb_image_loss_le {I V : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype V] [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq V]
    [Nonempty V] (D : Finset I) (r : ℕ) :
    uniformProb (fun f : I → V => (D.image f).card + r ≤ D.card) ≤
      (2 : ℝ) ^ D.card * ((D.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card V) ^ r
nodes.proof_route: Cover occupancy-loss event by representative subsets of size |D|-r; union bound at most2^|D| subsets and bound representative cardinality by |D|.

theorem combined_neighbors_eq_hashColumn_image {d n k b : ℕ} (g : Geometry d n)
    (s : Forms g.F d k) (h : Hashes g.F k b) (hfit : k * b ≤ n)
    (S : Finset (Fin (rowCount d n))) :
    neighbors (combined g s h) S =
      (neighbors (preliminary g s) S).image (hashColumn h hfit)
nodes.proof_route: Unfold exact matrix adjacency and show each neighbor is the layer-block hash column of an existing preliminary neighbor; this excludes padding columns exactly.

theorem global_hash_image_card_le {d n k b : ℕ} (g : Geometry d n)

theorem combined_not_expanding_witness {d n k b : ℕ} (g : Geometry d n)
    (s : Forms g.F d k) (h : Hashes g.F k b) (hb : 0 < b) (hfit : k * b ≤ n)
    (ε t : ℝ) (hbad : ¬ Expanding (combined g s h) (1 - ε) k t) :
    ∃ S : Finset (Fin (rowCount d n)), S.Nonempty ∧ (S.card : ℝ) ≤ t ∧
      ((neighbors (combined g s h) S).card : ℝ) < (1 - ε) * k * S.card
nodes.proof_route: Exact row weight removes the first failure alternative; unfold canonical IsLeftExpanding, cancel its row-count normalization, and exclude the empty witness.

theorem combined_failure_implies_image_loss (ε : ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (g : Geometry (dimension ε) n) (s : Forms g.F (dimension ε) (arity ε))
    (h : Hashes g.F (arity ε) (buckets ε n)) (hfit : arity ε * buckets ε n ≤ n)
    (hgood : PreliminaryGood ε n g s) (L : ℕ)
    (hL : (L : ℝ) ≤ ε * arity ε - dimension ε + 1)
    (S : Finset (Fin (rowCount (dimension ε) n)))
    (hsize : (S.card : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ (1 - ε))
    (hbad : ((neighbors (combined g s h) S).card : ℝ) <
      (1 - ε) * arity ε * S.card) :
    ((neighbors (preliminary g s) S).image (fun p => h p.1 p.2)).card + L * S.card ≤
      (neighbors (preliminary g s) S).card
nodes.proof_route: Combine canonical PreliminaryGood lower neighborhood bound, fixed-row-set expansion failure, and the untagged image cardinal bound. Natural cast arithmetic gives image.card+L*|S|≤preliminary.card.

theorem uniformProb_combined_fixed_set_le (ε : ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (g : Geometry (dimension ε) n) (s : Forms g.F (dimension ε) (arity ε))
    (hfit : arity ε * buckets ε n ≤ n) (hgood : PreliminaryGood ε n g s)
    (L : ℕ) (hL : (L : ℝ) ≤ ε * arity ε - dimension ε + 1)
    (S : Finset (Fin (rowCount (dimension ε) n)))
    (hsize : (S.card : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ (1 - ε)) (C : ℝ)
    (_hC : 0 ≤ C) (hbase : (arity ε : ℝ) * S.card / (buckets ε n : ℝ) ≤ C) :
    uniformProb (fun h : Hashes g.F (arity ε) (buckets ε n) =>
      ((neighbors (combined g s h) S).card : ℝ) < (1 - ε) * arity ε * S.card) ≤
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ arity ε * C ^ L) ^ S.card
nodes.proof_route: Use the exact full-function hashes equivalence and generic occupancy loss bound; bound the distinct preliminary domain by k*|S| and factor exponents by |S|.

theorem uniformProb_exists_combined_sets_le_pow (ε : ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (g : Geometry (dimension ε) n) (s : Forms g.F (dimension ε) (arity ε))
    (hfit : arity ε * buckets ε n ≤ n) (hgood : PreliminaryGood ε n g s)
    (L : ℕ) (hL : (L : ℝ) ≤ ε * arity ε - dimension ε + 1)
    (a : ℕ) (hsize : (a : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ (1 - ε)) (C : ℝ)
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hbase : (arity ε : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ (1 - ε) /
      (buckets ε n : ℝ) ≤ C) :
    uniformProb (fun h : Hashes g.F (arity ε) (buckets ε n) =>
      ∃ S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (rowCount (dimension ε) n))).powersetCard a,
        ((neighbors (combined g s h) S).card : ℝ) < (1 - ε) * arity ε * S.card) ≤
      ((rowCount (dimension ε) n : ℝ) * 2 ^ arity ε * C ^ L) ^ a
nodes.proof_route: Union bound over a-element row sets; Nat.choose_le_pow gives at most m^a sets, yielding base m*2^k*C^L.

theorem combined_bad_prob_le_two_base (ε : ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (g : Geometry (dimension ε) n) (s : Forms g.F (dimension ε) (arity ε))
    (hfit : arity ε * buckets ε n ≤ n) (hgood : PreliminaryGood ε n g s)
    (L : ℕ) (hL : (L : ℝ) ≤ ε * arity ε - dimension ε + 1)
    (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hbase : (arity ε : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ (1 - ε) /
      (buckets ε n : ℝ) ≤ C)
    (hhalf : (rowCount (dimension ε) n : ℝ) * 2 ^ arity ε * C ^ L ≤ 1 / 2) :
    uniformProb (fun h : Hashes g.F (arity ε) (buckets ε n) =>
      ¬ Expanding (combined g s h) (1 - ε) (arity ε) ((n : ℝ) ^ (1 - ε))) ≤
      2 * ((rowCount (dimension ε) n : ℝ) * 2 ^ arity ε * C ^ L)
nodes.proof_route: Index all nonempty canonically small row-set witnesses by j=|S|-1 below floor(t); sum their finite geometric bound, at most2B when B≤1/2.

theorem hash_expansion_envelope (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε ∧ ε < 1 / 2)
    (g : ∀ n, Geometry (dimension ε) n) :
    ∃ δ : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ n, 0 ≤ δ n) ∧
      Tendsto (fun n => δ n * (n : ℝ) ^ (1 / ε)) atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, ∀ s : Forms (g n).F (dimension ε) (arity ε),
        PreliminaryGood ε n (g n) s →
        uniformProb (fun h : Hashes (g n).F (arity ε) (buckets ε n) =>
          ¬ Expanding (combined (g n) s h) (1 - ε) (arity ε) ((n : ℝ) ^ (1 - ε))) ≤ δ n
nodes.proof_route: Choose delta(n)=2*hashRatio epsilon n. Its nonnegativity and scaled limit are exact HashParameters results; eventual hash parameters instantiate the finite quantitative theorem uniformly for every PreliminaryGood form.
